# Probability, calibration and decisions

::: {.partintro}
Before any neural network, any LLM or any Jev, every AI system has to answer one question honestly: *how sure are you?*

These five chapters build the answer from nothing. What learning is. What a probability means. How a model learns one. How to check whether it's honest. And how to turn it into an action.

It's the foundation the whole book stands on.
:::
